facts.fact: A Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy presentation lists the ICT4D Policy Statement 2018-2028 among the Gambia's policies, strategies and legal frameworks and sets out its nine priority areas; the document gives no date beyond its 2025 publication, which is used.

The ministry's presentation lists the ICT4D Policy Statement 2018-2028 among existing policies, strategies and legal frameworks, with its priority areas, and does not call it a draft; dated by the document's 2025 publication.
